summary_zh: 前文称赵露思7月17日官宣为周大福全球代言人后带动约1800万元销售并推高股价，强调其影响力。收录帖继续围绕品牌销售，具体改称仅抖音就达2700万且不含小红书、天猫、主品牌和线下。片段无后续回应；可判断为粉丝向正面传播，但数据来源未在对话中展开验证。

posts.text:
After #ZhaoLusi was announced as Chow Tai Fook’s Global Brand Ambassador on July 17, sales surged to around RMB 18 million, followed by an immediate rise in the company’s stock price.
This isn’t just a number it’s the power of Zhao Lusi’s global influence.
The Power of Zhao Lusi https://t.co/LoQQzHzECq
